basic_info.description: Owned by the last living Alcatraz guard, this generational Marina compound was occupied by the same family since the 1960s, where stories of playing chess with the "Bird Man" were passed to parents, children, and grandchildren inside these walls. Now vacant, this remarkable two-unit building presents a rare opportunity to embrace a Marina classic and craft its next chapter. The upper two-level residence offers 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths with a gracious living room, family room, built-in bar, formal dining, and breakfast room opening to a small deck. From the top-floor family room and bar, enjoy partial views of the Palace of Fine Arts and Golden Gate Bridge, while the walk-out deck provides an additional outlook toward the Downtown skyline. The lower flat includes 2 bedrooms, a split bath, formal dining and breakfast rooms, and a deck. Both residences feature fireplaces, original moldings, and period details, with vintage craftsmanship evident in the built-in secretaries. Additional highlights include garden-level rooms offering potential for creative reimagination (to be investigated by buyer), along with two-car garage parking and abundant storage.
